grammar.summary: 本课学习 it is said that 被动传闻结构。

points.title: It is said that...
points.explanation: 被动表传闻：It is said that the tree is cursed. 类似还有 It is believed/reported that... 真正主语后置。

examples.en: It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck.
examples.cn: 据说谁碰了这棵树谁就会倒霉。

points.title: in spite of 与 despite 辨析（巩固）
points.explanation: in spite of the number of visitors = 尽管，后接名词短语。

examples.en: The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago.
examples.cn: 这棵树是五十年前种在教堂附近的。
